items.html: Lubbers played for Holland in 154 matches between 1972 and 1996, including every ICC Trophy Tournament from 1979 until his retirement, captaining the national team from 1988 to 1996. He also remains their highest run-scorer in local cricket history.  Lubbers was more  than just a hard-hitting middle-order batsman; he was also a reliable offspinner and a safe pair of hands.
